label: TP
reason: User-supplied query string parameter flows directly to doSomething, which returns it as bar. The filename is constructed from bar and passed to FileInputStream constructor, enabling path traversal via ../ sequences. Although URL decoding occurs, it does not prevent traversal characters. The ESAPI encoder only encodes the error message in exception handling, not the actual file read operation.

evidence.note: User input extracted from query string and decoded
Input flows through doSomething to become bar used in filename construction
Filename passed to FileInputStream allowing path traversal
